mentions.place: Market Street, Center City East (Market East, around 11th-12th)
mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: walking here on Market Street my favorite Street to practice street photography in Philadelphia
mentions.locationEvidence: Street named outright. The stretch he is on is fixed by what he points at: the Hard Rock Cafe (0:51), 'a brewery across the street', 'big LED advertisements that are a reminiscent of Times Square' (1:04-1:10), 'this is the Pennsylvania Convention Center' (1:13), 'the reading terminals on the other side and you can actually walk through here to get there' (1:21-1:24), 'we got Chinatown over here' (5:28). That is Market Street east of City Hall around 11th-12th Streets.
mentions.notes: Explicit personal favorite, stated as his own practice. He does not say how much of Market Street he means; the landmarks only cover the 11th-12th block, so the corridor should be drawn short (roughly 10th-13th) unless another source extends it. No frame is made in this video: he is walking and talking to a GoPro, so there is no shot-here row.

mentions.place: 12th & Market (intersection by the Hard Rock Cafe / Reading Terminal headhouse)
mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: right so like here at uh Market Street we have a really great intersection Big crosswalks Lots of people the Hard Rock Cafe
mentions.locationEvidence: Cross street is never spoken. Inferred from landmarks: the Hard Rock Cafe sits at the corner of 12th & Market in the Reading Terminal headhouse; the Convention Center entrance and the walk-through to Reading Terminal Market are in that same building; the brewery and LED billboards across the street match the East Market development on the south side between 11th and 12th.
mentions.notes: Same person and same favorite street as the corridor row, so count once: this row is the small-and-accurate version of it. Medium because (a) the cross street is my inference from landmarks, not his words, and (b) he praises the intersection as a 'pocket' with lots of people rather than saying 'I shoot this corner'. A reviewer should confirm the corner from footage 0:46-1:27.
